command:
printf '%s\n' '[identity]'
printf 'managed_node=%s hostname=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$(hostname -f 2>/dev/null || hostname)"
printf '%s\n' '[service]'
sudo -n systemctl is-active etcd 2>&1
sudo -n systemctl show etcd --no-pager -p FragmentPath -p ExecStart -p EnvironmentFiles 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '[etcd-process]'
epid="$(pgrep -xo etcd 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -n "$epid" ]; then
  sudo -n sh -c "tr '\000' ' ' </proc/$epid/cmdline; printf '\\n'"
else
  printf '%s\n' 'etcd_process=absent'
fi
printf '%s\n' '[etcd-config-files]'
sudo -n find /etc/etcd -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %m\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
printf '%s\n' '[etcdctl-binaries]'
command -v etcdctl 2>&1 || true
sudo -n find /usr /opt -type f -name etcdctl -perm -111 -printf '%p\n' 2>/dev/null | head -20
printf '%s\n' '[candidate-client-configs]'
for f in /etc/etcd/etcdctl.env /etc/etcd/etcdctl.conf /etc/sysconfig/etcdctl /etc/default/etcdctl /etc/etcd/client.env; do
  if sudo -n test -f "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    printf 'file=%s\n' "$f"

done
